name: toolbar
title: Toolbar
description: A row of buttons and toggles that is one tab stop, moved through with the arrow keys.

props.name: preventFocusOnPress
props.description: Keep a press on an item from moving focus to it (an editor keeps its selection).

ToolbarSeparator.description: A thin rule between sets of items: the ButtonGroupSeparator look, a `separator` across the toolbar. Other props, `ref` included, go to its `div`.
